name: Sausage Quinoa Bowl with Spicy Maple-Roasted Cauliflower & Mushrooms
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place maple syrup, oil, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and paprika in a large bowl; whisk to combine the maple sauce.
Cut off leaves from the cauliflower, separate into small florets, and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; add to the bowl with the maple sauce.
Quarter mushrooms, add to the bowl, and toss to combine. Transfer veggies to a large baking dish and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking dish in the oven and roast until veggies are almost tender, about 15 minutes.
While the veggies are roasting, juice lemon into a small bowl; add mayo, maple syrup, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the lemon-mayo sauce and set aside.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces.

When the veggies are almost tender, remove from the oven and stir; add sausages, nestling them into the veggies. Return to the oven and continue to cook until veggies are tender and sausages are warmed through, 5-8 minutes more. (Or cook sausages according to package directions.) Remove from oven.
To serve, divide quinoa, roasted veggies, and sausages between bowls. Drizzle with lemon-mayo sauce and top with green onions. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
